# Rob Saric

> Personal site and notes of Rob Saric, founder of Caretrics (Ottawa). Caretrics reads an allied-health or rehab clinic's Jane.app data with read-only access, identifies the operational gaps affecting revenue, gives the work a clear owner, and measures what changed. Identified is not collected.

Rob Saric spent twenty years building software, including years as a systems architect inside large managed health-service organizations. He built Dentallytics, an analytics platform for dental service organizations, then went through twelve months of bookings, visits, and billing for 50+ allied health clinics, one clinic at a time, and found the same four gaps almost every time.

## Pages

- [Home](https://robsaric.com/): the five-stage clinic revenue model (Found, Booked, Treated, Retained, Paid), one worked signal from detection to verified outcome, three principles, latest notes.
- [My notes](https://robsaric.com/field-notes/): short first-person observations from clinics, dated, kept in order. Types: Field note, Shipped, Changed my mind. RSS: https://robsaric.com/rss.xml
- [Principles](https://robsaric.com/principles/): five principles for reviewing clinic operations: recover before you acquire; a signal without an owner is just another dashboard; AI must show its work; identified is not collected; billing problems usually start upstream.
- [How I count](https://robsaric.com/how-i-counted/): the standard behind every public number: what Caretrics reads, what is never inferred, and why identified is not collected.
- [About](https://robsaric.com/about/): background and the creed: people who do good should do well.
- [Archive](https://robsaric.com/archive/): 38 earlier posts on systems, flow, and leadership, 2009 to 2019, kept as written.
- [Contact](https://robsaric.com/contact/): rob@caretrics.com
